user.title: Sabiana Energy Smart
user.description: Connect to a Sabiana heat recovery unit over Modbus TCP.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host, port and slave ID, and that the unit is reachable.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often the unit is polled and how long to wait for its answer. A request that gets no answer takes up to timeout × (retries + 1) seconds before the poll is given up.

data_description.scan_interval: Default 3. Raise it if the logs show timeouts or the RS485 gateway is slow.
data_description.timeout: Default 3. How long to wait for each answer.
data_description.retries: Default 3. 1 is usually enough on a reliable link.
